result.brief: 提出 PhysRepair 智能体式“生成—诊断—修复”视频生成框架，用时空因果约束定位首个物理失效状态并局部重生成，结合经验增强的上下文学习提升物理合理性。
result.reason: Agentic generate-diagnose-repair framework for physically grounded video generation with localized regeneration and experience-augmented in-context learning; directly a video generation contribution.
